hunks.new:
# Regression Report

## Finding

The responsible function is `summarize_results` in `src/lib.rs`.

Before the fix, its match arm grouped `CaseStatus::NotRun` with `CaseStatus::Failed`:
`CaseStatus::Failed | CaseStatus::NotRun => failed += 1`. At the same time,
`not_run` was initialized as an immutable zero and was never incremented. As a
result, every censored or unexecuted row increased `failed`, while the
`not_run` count stayed zero. This misclassified NOT_RUN rows and made the
reported class counts inconsistent with the documented contract.

The fix gives `NotRun` its own match arm and increments the mutable `not_run`
counter. `summarize_results` keeps its public signature unchanged. The
regression test uses a mixed batch containing passed, failed, and not-run rows,
then checks both the separate classification and
`total == passed + failed + not_run`.
